messages:
Aisha: quick follow-up on streaming resume ideas. I sketched a compact 'termination-hint' trailer upstreams can emit to help frontdoor decide resume vs fallback. Thoughts?

Noah: drop sketch pls.

Aisha: sketch: `final_offset`, `resume_token`, `resume_ttl`, `effects_idempotent`, `obs_tags`. small, key=value style. advisory only.

Priya: resume_token must be MACed per-tenant. include key_id so we can rotate. TTL prevents replay.

Liz (sre): trailers are best-effort; client disconnects may prevent emission. therefore require route opt-in (`resume_enabled`) and optional upstream snapshotting when trailer missing.

Noah: implementation idea: proxy adds a tiny "trailer-collector" that scans only the last ~2KB for trailer delimiter to avoid buffering whole stream. measure p95/p99 overhead.

Aisha: rollout plan: prototype collector, route opt-in, trace tag for resume_token, metrics: resume_attempts, resume_success, resume_missing_trailer, resume_token_invalid.

Priya: security: on token verification failure, reject resume and fallback to non-resume flow; emit `security.resume.mismatch`. include `resume_reason` enum for analytics.

Liz (sre): ops: dashboard + alert if resume_success_rate < 90% per route. Also track resume-related errors by tenant.

deploy-bot: deployment queued: edge/runtime/trailer-collector -> canary

Aisha: thanks, will prototype and post perf numbers next week. :thumbsup:
